name: Rallly
description: Rallly is an open-source scheduling and collaboration tool and a self-hosted alternative to Doodle. Create a meeting poll with date and time options, share the link, and participants vote on what suits them without an account; the organizer then picks the final date and everyone gets notified.

notes.text: Rallly signs users in with codes sent by email: fill in the SMTP fields when creating the container, or set SMTP_* in /opt/rallly_data/.env and run systemctl restart rallly.
Without SMTP, request a code on the login page and read it in the container: su postgres -c "psql rallly -tAc 'select value from verifications'" (the digits before the colon).
Sign in with the admin email and open /control-panel to claim the admin role. Until registration is turned off there, anyone who reaches the page can create an account.

app_vars.name: var_admin_email
app_vars.label: Admin Email
app_vars.help: Support address, and the account that may claim the admin role at /control-panel

app_vars.name: var_smtp_port
app_vars.label: SMTP Port
app_vars.help: 465 uses implicit TLS, other ports STARTTLS
